title: agrostis castellana subsp. mutica
intro: Agrostis castellana subsp. mutica, commonly known as Castellane bent or Spanish bent, is a type of grass found in the mountainous regions of the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Agrostis castellana subsp. mutica include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic actions and health benefits of this plant, but it is known to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
